flora: Conifer cone (weathered woody structure, spiraling scales, chunky texture)
Needle cluster (tufted, rounded tips, olive-drab tone)
Bark fragment (thick, layered, sun-baked sandstone texture)
Winged seed (thin, translucent papery wing resting on dusty silt)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; emphasis on 'clumped' needle groups rather than individual sharp points; tactile, chunkily satisfying bark geometry suited for a high-fidelity 3D animated film.

visual_logic.composition: Quadrant layout: Top-Left: A mature woody cone; Top-Right: A cluster of olive-drab needles; Bottom-Left: A vertical study of thick, layered bark; Bottom-Right: Two winged seeds resting on a fragment of pale purple claystone.
visual_logic.ground: A bed of dusty tan sand and broken claystone blocks.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright, even diffused daylight to showcase the varied textures of the arid wood, needles, and mineral matrix clearly.
